research_question: Can a fixed dynamic selector choose among the three recovered successor ticket models using only their trailing 100 completed pre-target outcomes and improve one-ticket hit outcomes versus exact uniform 6-of-45 and fixed component models?
novelty: AGENTS.md research priority 2; distinct from E054 draw-frequency HHI regime classification and E059 candidate recall. No model-score lookahead, parameter grid, or post-result selector tuning.

eligibility.component_prediction_source: Already frozen cutoff-safe successor walk-forward; legacy A/C/contrarian models are not represented and must not be inferred.

selector.rule: For each target t, calculate each component's mean number of main-number hits over targets t-100..t-1. Select the model with the highest trailing mean.
selector.fallback: None; missing component row makes target invalid and must fail completeness checks.

comparator.selection_oracle: Per-target max of component hits, descriptive upper bound only; never eligible for deployment.

endpoints.primary: Mean hits per selected six-number ticket versus exact expectation 0.8.

block_bootstrap.inference: Paired per-target metric differences from exact null; moving-block bootstrap; two-sided percentile interval with alpha_per_endpoint=0.0125.

integrity_checks: Exactly one row for each target x component
Targets 201..1250 are contiguous for all three component models
Every ticket contains exactly six unique integers in 1..45
Recompute ticket hits against the frozen outcome count and verify stored hits exactly
Selection for target t reads only component hit rows from t-100..t-1
No target outcome is used in its own selection
No missing or duplicate candidate rows
limitations: Historical study on previously observed outcomes; it is not prospective confirmation.
Recovered successor models are not the missing legacy A/C/contrarian sources.
One-ticket selector performance does not qualify the separate three-line weekly purchase gate.
No final purchase lines, candidate numbers, freeze, or seal may be produced by this study.
promotion_effect: None. No purchase policy promotion or PASS status can be created.
